errors.text_span: Оста Y измерва стойността на индекса и е обозначена с етикета „BG40 (дясна скала)“.
errors.evidence: The chart has two Y-axes, one on the left and one on the right. Neither has a label. The description incorrectly states there is one Y-axis and uses a data series name as its label.
The description fails to mention the key structural feature of the chart: the presence of two different Y-axes (a left and a right one).

errors.text_span: Скалата е фиксирана, с начална стойност 1000 и крайна стойност 2200.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The chart has two scales. The left scale is from 0 to 2200. The right scale is from 0 to 1000. Neither starts at 1000.

errors.text_span: Основните стойности на оста Y са от 100 до 2200.
errors.evidence: This is an inaccurate and confusing summary of the axes' ranges. The left axis range is 0-2200 and the right is 0-1000.
The chart does not specify the units of the index values. While they are likely 'points', this is an assumption not explicitly stated in the figure.

errors.text_span: започва при стойност около 1000 точки през 2001 г.
errors.evidence: The blue line (SOFIX) starts at a value of approximately 100-150 in 2001, not 1000.

errors.text_span: оформя възходящ тренд до около 1600 точки през 2010 г.
errors.evidence: The blue line (SOFIX) does not have an ascending trend to 1600 in 2010. Its value in 2010 is between 400 and 500.

errors.text_span: регистрира спад до около 300 точки през 2013 г.
errors.evidence: The blue line (SOFIX) reaches its lowest point of ~300 in 2009, not 2013. The value in 2013 is approximately 400.

errors.text_span: достига максимум около 800 точки през 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The peak of the blue line (SOFIX) in the 2017-2018 period is approximately 700, not 800.

errors.text_span: започва при стойност около 1600 точки през 2001 г.
errors.evidence: The red line (BG40) starts in 2005, not 2001. Its starting value on the right axis is approximately 200, not 1600.

errors.text_span: достига максимум около 2000 точки през 2006 г.
errors.evidence: The red line (BG40) peaks in 2007, not 2006. Its peak value, read from the correct right-hand axis, is approximately 450, not 2000.

errors.text_span: намалява и оформя спускащ се тренд до около 600 точки през 2009 г.
errors.evidence: The low point of the red line (BG40) in 2009 is approximately 150 on the right axis, not 600.

errors.text_span: След това линията се възстановява и достига максимум около 1200 точки през 2014 г.
errors.evidence: The red line (BG40) does not have a peak of 1200 in 2014. The data for this line appears to end around 2014 with a value of approximately 300 on the right axis. This peak is fabricated.
The index name in the legend is 'BGBX40', not 'BGX40'.

errors.text_span: започва при стойност около 200 точки през 2001 г.
errors.evidence: The green line (BGBX40) starts in 2014, not 2001. Its starting value on the right axis is approximately 100, not 200.

errors.text_span: достига максимум около 600 точки през 2010 г.
errors.evidence: The green line (BGBX40) does not exist in 2010. It starts in 2014. This described peak is entirely fabricated.

errors.text_span: намалява и оформя спускащо се движение до около 150 точки през 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The green line (BGBX40) is rising in 2017, not falling. Its value is below 150 at that time.

errors.text_span: достига максимум около 300 точки през 2021 г.
errors.evidence: The final value of the green line (BGBX40) in 2021 is approximately 150 on the right axis, not 300.
